readOnly.title: Read-only for now
readOnly.text: A newer version of Folio changed this library's settings. You can still look around; update Folio to change courses and tags.

folder.label: Library folder
folder.help: Folio keeps track of everything in this folder. Choose Change… to open or start a library somewhere else.

semester.label: Semester
semester.help: The semester the Library and the toolbar show. Archived semesters stay in the semester menu.

deleted.label: Deleted files
deleted.description: When you delete a file or folder in Folio. Folio never deletes files for good.

rebuild.title: Rebuild search index
rebuild.description: Reads every file again. Try this if search misses a file you know is there.
rebuild.runningText: Rebuilding the search index. Search may miss some files until it finishes.
rebuild.done_one: Rebuilt the search index with {{count, number}} item.
rebuild.done_other: Rebuilt the search index with {{count, number}} items.
rebuild.cancelled: The rebuild was cancelled. Search may miss some files until the next scan.

courses.title: Courses in {{semester}}
courses.description: Each course has a code, a badge and a colour. Drag a course by its handle to reorder it, or use its menu.
courses.descriptionReadOnly: Each course has a code, a badge and a colour.
courses.empty: No courses in {{semester}} yet. Choose New course to add one.

noSemesters.title: No semesters yet
noSemesters.text: Add a semester to hold your courses. Folio makes a folder for it in your library.

courses.archivedDescription: Archived courses keep their folders, files and tags, and still show up in search.
courses.archiveSemesterDescription: Archived semesters move to the semester menu's Archived list. Nothing moves on disk.
courses.reorderFailed: Couldn't change the order of the courses

editCourse.title: Edit {{course}}
editCourse.name: Folder name
editCourse.nameHelp: Renames the course's folder. Its files and tags stay with it.
editCourse.codeHelp: Shown in paths and search results, for example MAT232.
editCourse.badgeHelp: Up to 3 letters. Leave it empty to use “{{badge}}”.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Tags work across all courses, and a file can have more than one. Drag a tag by its handle to reorder it, or use its menu.
tags.descriptionReadOnly: Tags work across all courses, and a file can have more than one.
tags.empty: No tags yet. Choose New tag to add one.
tags.reorderFailed: Couldn't change the order of the tags

deleteTag.title: Delete the tag “{{tag}}”?
deleteTag.text_one: It comes off the {{count, number}} file or folder that has it. The files stay where they are.
deleteTag.text_other: It comes off the {{count, number}} files and folders that have it. The files stay where they are.
deleteTag.textUnused: No file or folder has it yet.
deleteTag.done_one: Deleted the tag “{{tag}}” from {{count, number}} item
deleteTag.done_other: Deleted the tag “{{tag}}” from {{count, number}} items

reorder.moved: Moved {{name}} to position {{position, number}} of {{count, number}}

full.title: Full versions
full.description: For notes, code and other text files, and Word documents, Folio keeps every version, so you can compare and restore them.
full.examples: Examples of files with full versions

latest.title: Latest copy only
latest.description: For slides, PDFs, images, media and everything else, Folio records each change but keeps only the latest copy, to save space.
latest.examples: Examples of files with the latest copy only

fileTypes.note: Text files larger than 10 MB keep only the latest copy. Version history arrives in a later update of Folio; these rules decide what it keeps.

ignore.title: Ignore rules
ignore.description: Folio leaves out files and folders that match these patterns: they stay on disk but aren't in the library or in search. One pattern per line, as in a .gitignore file.
ignore.label: Patterns
ignore.help: Lines that start with # are comments. Start a line with ! to bring back something Folio leaves out by default.
ignore.saved: Saved. Folio is checking your library again.
ignore.tooLong: Ignore rules can be up to {{limit, number}} characters. Remove {{over, number}}.
ignore.invalidLine: Line {{line, number}} isn't a valid pattern, so Folio skips it.
ignore.invalidLines: Lines {{lines}} aren't valid patterns, so Folio skips them.

broken.title: These rules can't be used
broken.text: A pattern breaks the whole file, so no rule applies, not even Folio's defaults. Fix the patterns and save again.

defaults.summary: What Folio leaves out by default
defaults.text: These apply before your rules, in every library.
defaults.label: Folio's default ignore rules

device.label: Device name
device.help: Folio records it with the changes you make on this computer.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.text: Folio doesn't collect usage data. Your files stay on this computer and in the folders you choose.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: System follows Windows' light or dark mode.

motion.label: Reduce motion
motion.description: Turns off panel and dialog animations.

colours.title: Course and tag colours
colours.description: Ten named colours, each with a light and a dark version. Pick one for each course or tag.
colours.label: The ten colours

newSemester.title: New semester
newSemester.name: Semester name
newSemester.nameHelp: For example Fall 2026 or Winter 2027. Folio makes a folder for it in your library.
newSemester.rowsHelp: Press Enter in a name to add another row.

semester.NameInvalidCharacter: A semester name can't contain \ / : * ? " < > | because it becomes a folder name.

course.NameInvalidCharacter: A course name can't contain \ / : * ? " < > | because it becomes a folder name.
course.AlreadyExists: Another course in {{semester}} already has this name.

folder.NameTrailingDotOrSpace: A folder name can't end with a dot or a space.
folder.NameReserved: Windows reserves this name, like CON or NUL. Choose another.
folder.NameTooLong: This name is too long for a folder. Shorten it.
folder.PathTooLong: The folder's full path would be too long for Windows. Use a shorter name.

code.NameInvalidCharacter: Remove line breaks and other control characters.

badge.NameInvalidCharacter: Use letters or digits without spaces.

tag.NameInvalidCharacter: Remove line breaks and other control characters.

device.NameEmpty: Enter a name for this computer.
device.NameInvalidCharacter: Remove line breaks and other control characters.
